mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_requests (ingredient_id, supplier_id, category_id, quantity, request_date, due_date, status) VALUES (#{ingredientId}, #{supplierId}, #{categoryId}, #{quantity}, #{requestDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status});
mapper.select: SELECT pr.request_id AS requestId, pr.supplier_id AS supplierId, pr.category_id AS categoryId, pr.quantity AS quantity, pr.request_date AS requestDate, pr.due_date AS dueDate, pr.status AS status, i.id AS ingredientId, i.name AS ingredientName, c.category_name AS categoryName FROM purchase_requests pr LEFT JOIN ingredients i ON pr.ingredient_id = i.id LEFT JOIN categories c ON i.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY pr.request_id DESC
SELECT category_name FROM categories WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(request_id FROM 7 FOR 6) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM purchase_requests;
